newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Western Areas details hedging portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Western Areas details hedging portfolio.

text.p: JCI Ltd said on Tuesday that Western Areas Gold Mining Company Ltd in the December quarter took advantage of the higher spot prices for all gold produced.
It said that call options were sold at strike prices equal to or above the forward sales contract prices.
As at December 31, 1996 the hedging portfolio consisted of sales totalling 6.64 million ounces and a net purchased call option book of 3.42 million ounces.
JCI said that with the flexibility of the programme, 100 percent of production can participate in prices higher than the contract prices.
